name: Quick Pro UR:ONE
why_interesting: A lightweight road build pairing a 629 g claimed frame with Dura-Ace Di2 and a current official global price.
missing: Dated mainland-China RMB checkout observation and purchase route
Mainland delivery, duties, returns, and warranty-handling confirmation
source_note: The 2026-09-24 exact global Dura-Ace page lists US$6,899 under Global/USD, a size-M frame weight of 629 g ±5%, a 339 g ±5% fork, and a 115 g ±5% seatpost, but no mainland checkout or complete-bike weight. Its anonymous 5.9 kg owner review is not a manufacturer specification. MyBike.parts' ¥27,998/7.1 kg listing is for a separate 105 Di2 build. The separately sourced 6.5 kg regional RaceIt build remains an alternative configuration and is not generalized.

facts.complete_weight_status: No official complete-bike weight found after 50 registered source areas. The 2026-09-24 official page lists frame 629 g ±5%, fork 339 g ±5%, and seatpost 115 g ±5%, but no complete-bike weight. The anonymous 5.9 kg review and separate 105 Di2 listing are not the target manufacturer's claim; the 6.5 kg regional build remains configuration-specific.
facts.price_status: Current US$6,899 global price only; no attributable mainland CNY checkout amount after 50 registered areas. The 2026-09-24 exact Dura-Ace page still shows Global/USD and no mainland checkout; MyBike.parts' ¥27,998 figure is for a separate 105 Di2 build, not this Dura-Ace configuration.
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer says the exact UR:ONE preserves stiffness and control at low weight and cites Silverstone validation; qualitative claim without a public stiffness protocol

support_note: Official support page states a five-year frameset warranty for the original purchaser, one-year Shimano/SRAM coverage on complete bikes, mostly assembled delivery, and typical standard-bike delivery around three weeks; mainland-China service and delivery are not confirmed.

alternative_builds.label: RaceIt Dura-Ace Di2 with RORE steel-spoke wheels
alternative_builds.weight_basis: Regional specialist-retailer approximate claim, ±5%; size, pedals, accessories and weighing method unstated
alternative_builds.wheels: RORE stock wheels with steel spokes
alternative_builds.notes: Separate documented regional build; weight is not combined with the historical global FX reference or unresolved mainland options.
